weakness: Marks written AFTER seeing FT-2's numbers (reference/point-check-ft2.json, run 27 Oct at 4d4ba07) on the SAME 300 films, with the same Aariz output and expert tracings. New only: the plant directions (seed 20261029; FT-2 used 20261028) and the 20 mm distance (information only). A weaker test than a fresh one; quote it as 'a weaker re-test'. The fresh test is the confirmation on the owner's own films (Q-A'6). Test2 stays closed.
films: Ceph-400 train 001-150 and test1 151-300 (FT-2's caches, unchanged); Test2 held back
foldSeedWhy: the folds are FT-2's: cut with FT-2's seed (20261028), so each film is judged by the same fold's shape model as in FT-2; only the plant directions take the new seed (20261029)
moves: none: flag-only; no move line, no candidate spot, no re-assessment
g1Distances: every point of every film is planted at 10, 15 and 20 mm (a seeded direction each); only 15 mm decides; 10 and 20 mm are information only
gonionScope: Q-A'2 is read as: Gonion's own G1 line has no mark and is information only. Gonion stays one of the 15 in the G1 pool, as Q-A'1 states (FT-2's D1 set). G2 and G3 count every point, Gonion included, as FT-2's D2 and D5(a) did: a false flag on Gonion is still a false flag.
g4: reported with counts, per point; no mark
g5: reported, no mark; the 1-in-5,000 figure is never shown on screen; the hover quotes the measured rate, 'about 1 in 700 on Ceph-400' (Q-A'5)
controls: two-sided, as FT-2: nasion 15 mm off flagged on all 10 control films, and the same films unplanted not all flagged; B alone 10 mm forward flagged >= 90%; the whole lower jaw 5 mm forward flagged <= 0.5% of points. A control that does not hold makes the instrument broken (exit 1), never a verdict.
nothing: a mark that counted nothing stops the run with an error; it is never a pass

verdicts.go: G1 pooled, G1 each point but Gonion, G2, G3 and every control pass -> exit 0: Stage A' may be built, flag-only
verdicts.no-go: the controls hold but any of G1 pooled, G1 each, G2, G3 fails -> exit 3: the net is not built; back to the owner
verdicts.broken: any control fails -> exit 1: the instrument cannot be trusted; nothing is concluded
